8 Days Ol Pejeta Aberdare Samburu Lake Nakuru and Maasai Mara Safari

Package overview

Embark on an unforgettable 8-day safari through some of Kenya’s most iconic wildlife destinations. Begin at , home to the rare black rhino, chimpanzees, and vast herds of elephants. Then explore the lush, forested slopes of the , with its waterfalls, wildlife, and serene landscapes. Travel north to

  • Ol Pejeta
  • The Last Northern White Rhinos: The most poignant highlight is visiting Najin and Fatu, the last two remaining northern white rhinos in the world, a truly once-in-a-lifetime encounter that underscores the importance of global conservation efforts.
  • Rhino Sanctuary: Ol Pejeta is East Africa's largest black rhino sanctuary, with a robust and growing population of over 100 individuals, offering excellent opportunities to see these endangered animals in their natural habitat
  • The "Big Five": The conservancy is home to all members of the Big Five: elephant, lion, leopard, buffalo, and rhino. Its high wildlife-to-land ratio makes sightings of these iconic species fairly common.
  • Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary : This is the only place in Kenya where you can see chimpanzees. The sanctuary provides a lifelong refuge for chimps rescued from various traumatic situations across Africa, in an agreement with the Jane Goodall Institute.
  • Aberdare
  • Nocturnal Wildlife Viewing: The primary highlight for many visitors is the unique opportunity to view wildlife at night from the comfort of an elevated "tree hotel" like The Ark or Treetops Lodge. These lodges overlook floodlit waterholes and salt licks, attracting a steady stream of animals after dark, including elephants, buffaloes, and potentially leopards, hyenas, and the giant forest hog.
  • The Rare Bongo Antelope: The park is a crucial sanctuary for the critically endangered Bongo, a large and beautiful forest antelope that is very difficult to spot elsewhere.

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Nairobi - Ol Pejeta

Depart Nairobi in the morning and drive north to Ol Pejeta Conservancy (approx. 3.5–4 hours). Afternoon game drive in Ol Pejeta, spotting rhinos, lions, elephants, and chimpanzees. Optional evening visit to Sweetwaters Chimpanzee Sanctuary. Overnight at Ol Pejeta Conservancy.

02Day 2 | Ol Pejeta – Aberdare National Park

Early morning game drive at Ol Pejeta. Drive to Aberdare National Park (approx. 3 hours). Afternoon game drive or nature walk amid forests, waterfalls, and wildlife like elephants and buffalo. Overnight in Aberdare National Park.

03Day 3 | Aberdare – Samburu National Reserve

Depart early for Samburu National Reserve (approx. 5–6 hours). Afternoon game drive, spotting Samburu’s unique wildlife including gerenuks and reticulated giraffes. Overnight at Samburu.

04Day 4 | Full Day in Samburu National Reserve

Full day of morning and afternoon game drives along the Ewaso Ng’iro River. Optional visit to a local Samburu village. Overnight at Samburu.

05Day 5 | Samburu – Lake Nakuru National Park

Depart Samburu early and drive to Lake Nakuru (approx. 5–6 hours). Afternoon game drive, famous for flamingos, rhinos, and other wildlife. Overnight at Lake Nakuru National Park.

06Day 6 | Lake Nakuru – Masai Mara National Reserve

Optional early morning game drive at Lake Nakuru. Drive to Masai Mara (approx. 5–6 hours). Afternoon game drive in the iconic Masai Mara, home to the Big Five. Overnight at Masai Mara.

07Day 7 | Full Day in Maasai Mara

Full day of morning and afternoon game drives. Optional hot air balloon safari over the savannah (extra cost). Overnight at Masai Mara.

08Day 8 | Maasai Mara to Nairobi

Optional early morning game drive. Drive back to Nairobi (approx. 5–6 hours) or transfer to Wilson Airport. Safari ends on arrival in Nairobi. Please note that this safari is fully customizable to suit your travel preferences. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast. Our experienced Tour Consultants at Magical Africa Safaris are always ready to guide you and help tailor your trip for the best possible wildlife holiday experience.
